in_arabic.name: بريدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني القطعة من الثلج
in_arabic.long_meaning: بريدة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'براد' التي تعني الثلج أو القطعة من الثلج. ورد اسم بريدة في الحديث النبوي الشريف، حيث كان اسمًا لأحد الصحابة، وهو بريدة بن الحصيب الأوسي. يعتبر اسم بريدة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وذات دلالة دينية وروحانية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: بریدة
in_urdu.meaning: بریدة کا مطلب ہے برف کا ٹکڑا، ایک خوبصورت اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: بریدة ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر علمی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے برف کا ٹکڑا یا ٹھنڈک. یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں معروف ہے کیونکہ بريدة بن الحصیب اوسی ایک صحابی رسول تھے. اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے، جو اس کی دینی اور روحانی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے.

in_english.name: Buraida
in_english.meaning: A piece of ice or coldness, a beautiful Islamic name
in_english.long_meaning: Buraida is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'a piece of ice' or 'coldness'. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'barad', which signifies ice or cold. Buraida bin al-Hushayb al-Osî was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, making the name significant in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes purity, calmness, and serenity. The name Buraida is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its spiritual and cultural importance.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history, Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, one of the earliest converts to Islam and the first Caliph, sent an expedition under the command of Buraidah ibn Al-Husbin Al-Aslami. This military campaign, known as the Expedition of Buraidah, aimed to maintain the territorial gains of the Muslim state and to protect the early Muslim community in Medina from threats. The name Buraidah has since been associated with bravery, leadership, and military prowess in the Islamic world. Additionally, Buraidah is recorded in Islamic texts as an excellent and respected scholar, a hospitable and generous guest, and a devout worshiper.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Buraidah denotes someone who journeys in faith. As travel and exploration are significant aspects of many Islamic pilgrimages, the name Buraidah evokes the idea of a spiritual pilgrimage - a tireless and dedicated quest for knowledge, wisdom, and a deeper understanding of the divine. It can also symbolize the inner journey towards self-improvement and closeness to God, encouraging perseverance and compassion along the way. Buraidah may also remind us of our final journey towards the eternal destination of paradise, urging us to prepare ourselves and live in accordance with the teachings of Islam.
